label: Recipe Book
description: A cookbook of roughly 900 recipes and cocktails with generated illustrations, a meal planner that works in real dates, and a pantry and bar you can cook from.

model_slots.label: Semantic search
model_slots.note: Shares the generic @embed role with every retrieval rail; embedders are out of the Admin -> Rails panel's scope by design, so there is no RAIL_MODEL_SLOTS counterpart. The semantic index records the concrete model that built it and falls back to lexical search when the role resolves elsewhere.

notes: Moved off dev port 5240 to 5280: it collided with bouquet AND terminal-fun, so two of the three had to move. The second `npm run dev` to start loses, and its /api proxy silently belongs to whichever rail booted first.

The icon slot is an IMAGE backend (flux-schnell) running on the broker's media worker, not an Ollama tag — it never appears in /v1/models, so any future chip must resolve it against media state rather than the model list.
Don't normalise the culinary assistant to @chat or the icon to a generic image role; both are deliberately rail-specific roles.
Bulk icon regeneration needs a raised RECIPE_BOOK_BROKER_TIMEOUT and big chunks (~250) to amortise the model cold-load — see CLAUDE.local.md.

max_request_bytes is 251 MiB because one import takes up to 10 files of 25 MiB each (extraction.MAX_FILES and MAX_FILE_BYTES) plus 1 MiB of multipart framing; the gateway refuses a larger body (RC035). A total budget per import would let this fall back to the platform default.
